entities.name: Hoyte's Economic Liberalization
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: After Burnham's death in 1985, Desmond Hoyte inherited a bankrupt economy and pivoted toward market reforms under IMF structural adjustment. The Economic Recovery Programme reversed nationalizations and opened Guyana to foreign investment.
